title: Our Class, Our Voice
description: Share an idea with a reason, choose and plan a class service project, and reflect on how taking part can help a community.
learningFocus: Express an opinion about a shared classroom concern and give a simple reason for that choice.
Participate in planning and reflecting on an age-appropriate project that helps the classroom or community.
adultGuidance: Read the choices aloud and invite your child to explain an idea in their own words. These activities are open-ended: on page 1, either choice is acceptable when supported by a reason; page 2 records the child's selected project and plan; page 3 should be completed after the real project and may be written by an adult using the child's exact words.

seo.title: Classroom Community Worksheets for Kindergarten | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Three printable Kindergarten civics activities for sharing ideas, planning a class service project, and reflecting on helping others.
